scope: Static source/contract review only. No native process or Cargo command was executed by reviewer. No runner/source edits.
checks: Shared qualification-owner-pin.lock is acquired nonblocking before source checks, fetch, checkout, compilation or tests; target owner ties target-pin to the same source-pin checkout.
Exact failed unchanged r4 source and fixed-hash completed C2 receipt are prerequisites. Updated commit/tree/clean status, full reviewed 99 changed paths and all four source SHA values must match.
Pinned executable hashes are checked. Four Rust files receive read-only rustfmt --check. Source manifests cover before/after execution.

Artifact binding is unfiltered workspace/default --no-run JSON, not a single-package feature graph. Exact package_id plus target kind/profile selects one app_cli harness and one normal grok_pcm. Both paths remain inside exclusive target; normal path must be embedded in harness; both SHA before/after retained.
--list must exactly equal all 12 declared test names; runtime is no-selector --nocapture with default libtest parallelism. Any inherited RUST_TEST_THREADS setting is rejected.

At most 20 serial harness invocations; 300s runtime window and 870s whole-job internal budget inside 900s outer cap. Actual runtime-window elapsed is checked at end, including final round. Any nonzero, timeout or wrong full 12-pass summary stops without replacement.

Round PID and running entry are persisted immediately after Popen; per-round raw/hash/elapsed retained. Exception-finally preserves interrupted round and source/artifact verification failures separately.
Timeout cleanup records owned process-group signal requests, actual leader reap and final group existence without claiming all descendants joined.
Schedule caveat explicitly identifies the child-lifetime barrier. Existing 60ms, single bind and product deadlines remain source facts; finite repeat window does not erase three historical failures.
delivery_requirements_retained: Outer launcher must preserve actual runner/helper bytes and before/after hashes, environment and enforced cgroup/900s runtime receipt as planned by gate.
A static review does not certify execution success, bound compiler subprocess descendants beyond the outer runtime containment, or establish a cause for any historical failure.
